subject: Private cluster activation window — EU <-> APAC (coordination & network checks)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: SatoriCloud Ops <ops@satoricloud.com>, Kia Park <kia.park@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private cluster activation window — EU <-> APAC (coordination & network checks)

Hi all,

We're targeting an activation window for the Acme Retail private deployment between EU and APAC on Monday May 10 (UTC-friendly window: 2027-05-10 02:00–06:00 UTC). This is the final coordination thread before we flip the controlplane and enable cross-region standby routing.

Please confirm the following by EOD Tuesday May 4:
- Confirm egress IP list(s) for the APAC standby cluster and exact /32s we should allow from Acme's firewall.
- Confirm KMS key provisioning in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1 (key names in the runbook).
- Validate peering ACL for 10.240.0.0/16 <-> 10.241.0.0/16 and whether your edge proxies will advertise ASNs during the temporary cutover.
- Any required windows for DocuSign/MCOPA final signatures (we've attached the signed copy but confirm acceptance).

I've attached the activation-runbook (checklist + rollback steps) and the current network-diagram. Vivek and Karthik — can you also sanity-check the canary sample (we plan a limited 10% traffic canary for 15 minutes before full traffic shift)?

Attachments: [Attachment: activation-runbook.pdf (PDF, 412KB)], [Attachment: network-diagram-v1.png (PNG, 220KB)], [Attachment: MCOPA-signed.pdf (PDF, 128KB)]

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partnerships Manager — Redwoods Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

---
Private deployment activation checklist (high-level) included in runbook:
1) Prechecks: KMS+certs, peering routes, allowed egress list verified
2) Warm standby verification: KV cache priming & prefix caching validation
3) Canary: 10% traffic, 15m, automated rollback on 5xx > 1% or latency P95 increase > 50%
4) Full traffic shift + post-cut monitoring (1h heightened observability)

From: SatoriCloud Ops <ops@satoricloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kia Park <kia.park@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 02:41:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Private cluster activation window — EU <-> APAC (coordination & network checks)

Vanessa / team — thanks for the note. Acme ops here. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Egress IPs (APAC standby): 203.0.113.45, 203.0.113.46 (we will provide signed ACLs to Acme firewall team).
- KMS: keys provisioned in eu-west-1 (redwood-acme-eu-kms) and ap-south-1 (redwood-acme-ap-kms). Access policies include Redwood service account rn-svc-privdeploy.
- Peering: we've validated the 10.240/16 <-> 10.241/16 routes. Edge proxy will not advertise a new ASN during the canary; they'll keep the same ASN and mark the standby as lower priority (BGP MED).
- DocuSign: MCOPA signed by legal; we attached the signed PDF to your DocuSign envelope and are ready to proceed.

One ask: during the canary, can you expose a read-only routing path for sample traffic to our telemetry collector (IP 198.51.100.10) so we can cross-validate trace IDs? We want to mirror a subset of traces for latency comparison.

We are green from operations but will stand by for your final go.

—Jamal (SatoriCloud Ops)
[Attachment: satoricloud-acl-signed.txt (TXT, 6KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: SatoriCloud Ops <ops@satoricloud.com>, Kia Park <kia.park@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster activation window — EU <-> APAC (coordination & network checks)

Thanks Jamal — and thanks Vanessa for pulling this together. A few operational notes and one potential issue to flag before we finalize the canary plan: 

1) Routing/ASN: If the standby keeps the same ASN and uses BGP MED for de-prioritization, we need to confirm BGP timers (30s keepalive/90s hold are our default) — during a fast rollback we need the standby to withdraw quickly. Can Satori reduce hold timers for the cutover window? Lowering timers to 15/45 would speed failback but increases churn risk.

2) KMS access: Service account rn-svc-privdeploy has been granted decrypt/list permissions. We still need the customer to confirm rotation windows; if a key rotation happens within 30 days of activation we should delay.

3) Telemetry mirror: fine with exposing read-only path to 198.51.100.10. We'll add a temporary route and ensure no PII is forwarded to the collector (filters in the runbook).

4) Canary fail criteria: update to include tokenization regressions (we'll run a 50-prompt smoke test set) and add a healthcheck that asserts KV cache hit rate >= 70% for the canary sample.

Marissa — can you sign off on escalation contacts and the decision tree? I'm attaching the small checklist snippet I want on the page for rapid callouts.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Deployment Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: SatoriCloud Ops <ops@satoricloud.com>, Kia Park <kia.park@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster activation window — EU <-> APAC (coordination & network checks)

All — good progress. I'm authorizing the go for the canary on 2027-05-10 02:00 UTC with the following gating items that must be closed before we start the 10% traffic shift: 

- Acme confirms firewall rule change ticket is scheduled and applied (include effective timestamp)
- SatoriCloud confirms reduced BGP timers for the activation window or provides a documented rollback timing plan
- KMS rotation window confirmed (no rotation scheduled within next 30 days)
- Telemetry mirror path tested end-to-end (we need a successful trace match sample from Satori)
- Docs: signed MCOPA and DocuSign envelope final (we have that in attachments)

If any gating item fails, we abort and follow the rollback checklist in the runbook. During the canary we'll have a 30-minute on-call overlap between platform, infra, SRE, and Acme ops for immediate decisioning. Karthik — please schedule the temporary route and update the runbook paragraph with the exact route statements you will apply.

I'll publish the final activation notice once all items are green; expecting confirmations by EOD. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Deployments — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
